tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: borrower intimates RE of intention not to renew before the period stipulated in the loan agreement, and facility gets closed on the due date
tuples.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, no pre-payment charges shall be applicable if the borrower intimates the RE of his/ her/ its intention not to renew the facility before the period as stipulated in the loan agreement, provided that the facility gets closed on the due date.
